title: Nvidia's search for a chief executive is now a test of the entire AI trade
summary: The board has approached Arm's Rene Haas, insists it has not formally engaged anyone, and has put finance chief Colette Kress in charge while founder-board member Harvey Jones chairs the company for the first time - a thin structure for a firm that had no chair and no visible succession plan. The market has already voted: about $5.8 trillion in early October to $3.9 trillion on Friday, with results due Tuesday and analysts expecting 90% earnings growth on $109 billion of revenue. Governance and demand now arrive in the same week.
